description: "issue", "PR" or "pull request" followed by a number becomes a GitHub reference (`PR #712`); the spoken word stays, only `#` and digits are added. Negatives: a number after one of those words that is not a reference, and numbers elsewhere that stay as spoken. Polish-only, agent profile: the input is what the recognizer writes, including the glued `PR349` it produces and number words.

cases.spokenForm: Can you check PR 712 and tell me why the Linux job failed?
cases.intendedText: Can you check PR #712 and tell me why the Linux job failed?
cases.notes: Recognizer already wrote digits: only the # is missing.

cases.spokenForm: Rebase this branch on PR349 before you push.
cases.intendedText: Rebase this branch on PR #349 before you push.
cases.notes: The recognizer glues PR to the number (seen twice in the owner's history).

cases.spokenForm: look at issue five sixty three it has the repro steps for the crash
cases.intendedText: Look at issue #563, it has the repro steps for the crash.
cases.notes: Number spoken as words after "issue" becomes digits.

cases.spokenForm: the fix is in pull request seven twelve so wait for it to merge before you start
cases.intendedText: The fix is in pull request #712, so wait for it to merge before you start.
cases.notes: "pull request" keeps its spoken words; only the number becomes #712.

cases.spokenForm: this is a follow up to issue seven oh five so read that one first
cases.intendedText: This is a follow up to issue #705, so read that one first.
cases.notes: "oh" read as zero inside a spoken number.

cases.spokenForm: Close issue 718 once the eval passes and link it from issue 386.
cases.intendedText: Close issue #718 once the eval passes and link it from issue #386.
cases.notes: Two references in one sentence; both get the #.

cases.spokenForm: wait five minutes then check PR 568 again and retry three times if it is still red
cases.intendedText: Wait five minutes, then check PR #568 again and retry three times if it is still red.
cases.notes: Only the number after PR changes; the other number words stay words.

cases.spokenForm: the second issue is that the timer never fires when the Mac sleeps
cases.intendedText: The second issue is that the timer never fires when the Mac sleeps.
cases.notes: Negative: an ordinal before "issue" is not a reference.

cases.spokenForm: This is PR 2 of 3 in the stack, so keep main as the base branch.
cases.intendedText: This is PR 2 of 3 in the stack, so keep main as the base branch.
cases.notes: Negative: a position in a stack, not a PR number.

cases.spokenForm: I found two issues in the parser and one PR that fixes both of them
cases.intendedText: I found two issues in the parser and one PR that fixes both of them.
cases.notes: Negative: counts before the word stay words and get no #.

cases.spokenForm: Regarde la PR 712 et dis-moi pourquoi le job Linux a échoué.
cases.intendedText: Regarde la PR #712 et dis-moi pourquoi le job Linux a échoué.

cases.spokenForm: Rebase la branche sur la PR349 avant de pousser.
cases.intendedText: Rebase la branche sur la PR #349 avant de pousser.

cases.spokenForm: l'issue cinq cent soixante-trois décrit le crash et les étapes pour le reproduire
cases.intendedText: L'issue #563 décrit le crash et les étapes pour le reproduire.

cases.spokenForm: la pull request sept cent douze corrige ça donc attends qu'elle soit mergée
cases.intendedText: La pull request #712 corrige ça, donc attends qu'elle soit mergée.

cases.spokenForm: C'est la PR 2 sur 3 de la pile, donc garde main comme branche de base.
cases.intendedText: C'est la PR 2 sur 3 de la pile, donc garde main comme branche de base.
cases.notes: Negative: a position in a stack, not a PR number.

cases.spokenForm: j'ai trouvé deux issues dans le parser et une PR qui corrige les deux
cases.intendedText: J'ai trouvé deux issues dans le parser et une PR qui corrige les deux.
